review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped Mathlib for the definitions it introduces: ofMulDiscriminant, discriminantEquiv, the deprecated divDiscriminant, and the Sturm-bound declarations. I also checked the neighbouring definitions it builds on: CuspForm.mulModularForm, CuspForm.mcast, toCuspForm and CuspForm.equivCuspFormSubmodule. I found no independent competing definition. ofMulDiscriminant is a thin wrapper over mulModularForm and mcast, and discriminantEquiv is a new linear equivalence for a different purpose than equivCuspFormSubmodule. The deprecated divDiscriminant aliases discriminantEquiv, so it is a transition shim and not a competing concept. The remaining items are theorems, and the rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication. I did not find any other definition of the Sturm bound or the dimension formula in Mathlib, apart from the unrelated polynomial Sturm sequences.
